newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen Benelux '96 net dips 1.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen Benelux '96 net dips 1.1 pct.

text.p: (in millions of yuan unless stated, against 1995 figures)
Earnings per share 0.17 yuan vs 0.19 yuan
Net assets per share 2.42 yuan vs 2.49 yuan
Company name: Shenzhen Benelux Enterprise Co Ltd.
Note: The results, published in an annual report in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times on Wednesday, were calculated under Chinese accounting standards.
Based on international standards, the company posted a net profit of 8.20 million yuan for 1996. It did not give a comparative figure.
The firm, a floppy disk maker, proposed a one-for-10 bonus issue based on 1996 profits, pending approval of shareholders at a meeting on June 6, the company said.
Trading in the company's B shares will be suspended on Wednesday morning and will resume in the afternoon, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange has said.
